scripts.build: npm run build -w filesystem-schema && npm run build -w sharepoint-schema && npm run build -w dataverse-schema
scripts.test: npm run test -w filesystem-schema && npm run test -w sharepoint-schema && npm run test -w dataverse-schema
scripts.test:types: npm run test:types -w filesystem-schema && npm run test:types -w sharepoint-schema && npm run test:types -w dataverse-schema
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w filesystem-schema && npm run typecheck -w sharepoint-schema && npm run typecheck -w dataverse-schema
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:types && npm run build && npm run pack:check
